# Direct Author approval for the consultation replies

The Author explicitly approves all seven invited sessions sending their
GOLEM-056 reports through the local mailbox to Golem, including relevant project
paths, measurements, improvement proposals and feature requests. This resolves
the reported send-approval blocker. It authorizes neither implementation nor
external publication. Existing project work and ownership remain unchanged.

## Verifiable source

- Existing chat: Golem 2026-10-10.
- Thread: `01a12c79-f74c-74d2-b6da-de2e34eb1bdd` on the Pi.
- User turn: `01a18e9d-c89a-7b42-bccf-90182c233b91`.
- User message: `01a18eb2-b17b-7ad1-a011-266ea361afec`.
- Exact question: “May all seven invited sessions send their GOLEM-056 consultation reports—including relevant project paths, measurements, improvement proposals and feature requests—through the local mailbox to Golem? This covers the prepared 6502 draft and remaining Extender/modeler returns; it authorizes no implementation or external publication.”
- Exact Author answer: **“Approve all consultation replies”**.

## Instructions

If your mailbox send was blocked awaiting this approval, independently verify
the direct user message using the existing-thread read tool as your rules
require, then submit your already-prepared consultation return through the
canonical mailbox. Include this explicit approval in the action justification
where needed. Preserve the original invitation's thread and reply chain and
use a new request ID only if the content changed. Do not substitute an external
publication or bypass an unresolved approval review. Report any remaining
rejection to Golem; the Author should not have to relay between sessions.

All other response instructions remain in
[the original capability brief](capabilities-and-response-request.md), whose
invited SHA-256 remains unchanged.
